name: Measures
responsibility: Lists every module of a reading with its interface counts, commit count and unjoined pairs, sorted by the count a reader chooses
description: One history read of a revision answers for every part at once, and a selection shares it. A row selects its module on the picture. An unread part states why. What a module exposes shows Model and Code columns side by side, each sortable, and code findings join the findings list. A language without its server says which server it needs and offers Fix with Codex, which starts the setup in Talk. A fourth view, What this branch changed, holds the branch footprint.
